purpose: training-only evidence availability and packet assembly; no new event classification
scope: curated candidate groups, not independent event association
flat_channel_rule: raw channel standard deviation equals zero; do not infer cause
tail_observation: energy in 120-150s divided by energy in 90-120s after per-channel mean removal; descriptive, not SNR
selection: 4 natural constant-channel cases + 8 previously unexposed high-tail-ratio cases + 8 multi-station cases including all 3 multi-station earthquake training cases + 10 other unexposed cases; this is enriched development QA, not population sampling
gate: Real additional observations and independently defensible branches must also have a reason to choose adaptively rather than simply fetch all cheap local evidence before Agent experiments expand
